label: English (United States)
promptContext: Language: US English, US spelling (color, gray). Audience: US homeowners and renters. Measurements: imperial — quote roll sizes like 20.5 in × 33 ft and wall areas in square feet; never use metric. Currency: USD with $ symbol. Terminology: 'wallpaper paste' (not adhesive), 'accent wall', 'drywall', 'nursery', 'baseboard', 'crown molding'. Cultural context: renting with security deposits is common — removable and peel-and-stick options matter; mention sample swatches shipped to your door. Search phrasing tends to be '<style> wallpaper for <room>'.
